whatToWatch.text: 3-1 and riding a win streak into a home date with the 49ers — Seattle's laid 3 points as the favorite, and the Lumen crowd gets a division heavyweight with real standings weight behind it.

Defense is the story: Seattle's allowing just 18.25 points a game with 2.75 sacks per contest, and San Francisco will be without Nick Bosa (one of four 49ers ruled out, along with James Thompson Jr.) to pressure back.

Don't expect a track meet — the total sits at 45.5, and the Niners are surrendering a stingy 16 points per game. Seattle plays shorthanded too, with four out (Chazz Surratt, George Holani, Julian Neal) and one questionable, so depth and field position could decide this one.

newsBlurb.text: Divisional football returns to Lumen Field when San Francisco visits for a Week 5 Sunday showdown. The 49ers get the full Seattle treatment — crowd noise, a hostile October afternoon, and a rivalry that rarely needs extra motivation. Kickoff details, TV, radio and streaming info are all set for October 11.
